entries: The Elemental appears in an unoccupied space of your choice you can see in range. It takes on the statistics and appearance of an {@filter Elemental of CR 3 or lower|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&3]|type=elemental}, so long as its makeup matches that of the material component.

entries.name: Combat
entries: The Elemental shares your initiative and it acts during your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Elemental does not receive a command, or its commands are completed, it will only defend itself.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

entries.name: Control
entries: If your concentration on this spell is broken, the Elemental remains, but is no longer under your control. For the duration of the spell, or until it is reduced to 0 hit points, the Elemental will act according to its alignment, spreading chaos and destruction wherever it can.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the CR of Elemental that you can conjure increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Conjure Fey (Alternate)

m.text: a Tiny object worth at least 50 gold containing the promise of a Fey, willingly gifted to you

entries: You grasp the material component of this spell and call its Fey spirit to your aid. While your concentration lasts, the Fey Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands to the letter. For the duration, the Fey uses the rules below:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The Fey spirit appears in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. It takes on the appearance and statistics of any {@filter Fey of CR 3 or lower|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&3]|type=fey}.

entries.name: Combat
entries: The Fey shares your initiative and it acts on your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Fey does not receive any commands, or its commands are completed, it moves and defends itself as best it can.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

entries.name: Control
entries: If the spell ends because your concentration was broken, the Fey remains, but is no longer under your control. For the duration of the spell, or until reduced to 0 hit points, the Fey acts according to its alignment, and either becomes Hostile toward you and your allies or flees.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the CR of Fey this spirit can take on increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Conjure Fiend

components.m: a Fiend's true name

entries: Speaking its true name, you conjure a {@filter Fiend of CR 4 or lower|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&4]|type=fiend} to your aid. While your concentration lasts, it is Indifferent to you and your allies and follows your commands to the letter. For the duration, the Fiend uses the rules below:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The Fiend appears in an unoccupied space of your choice you can see within range. When it appears, you can force the Fiend to take on the appearance and statistics of another Fiend of your choice equal to its CR, or lower.

entries.name: Combat
entries: The Fiend shares your initiative and acts on your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Fiend does not receive any commands, or its commands are completed, it can move defend itself with prejudice.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

entries.name: Control
entries: If your concentration on this spell is broken, the Fiend remains. It instantly returns to its true form and is no longer under your control. For the duration of the spell, or until it is reduced to 0 hit points, it is Hostile to you and your allies, and will act according to its alignment. Devils seek to kill the spellcaster, and Demons kill indiscriminately.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the CR of the Fiends that you can conjure increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Conjure Volley (Alternate)

components.m: a single piece of ammunition and a ranged weapon, or one thrown weapon, all nonmagical

entries: You fire one piece of nonmagical ammunition from a ranged weapon or throw a nonmagical thrown weapon into the air and choose a point within 60 feet.

The ammunition or weapon explodes into a multitude of exact copies of it, which fall in a 30-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on the point you chose. Creatures within that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. They take {@damage 6d8} damage of the weapon's type on a failure, and half as much on a success. The ammunition or weapons created by this spell disintegrate once the effects of this spell are resolved.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the damage of this spell increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|3-9|1d8}, and the radius of the cylinder increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Counterspell (Alternate)

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell

entries: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. You and the target both make an ability check with your respective spellcasting abilities. The target adds the level of the spell it is casting to its ability check, and you add the level at which you cast this counterspell to your ability check.
If you know the spell the creature is attempting to cast or if you have it prepared you have advantage on this ability check, unless you are using this spell against another counterspell.
If the result of your ability check is greater then the result of the target's ability check, its spell fails and has no effect.

spell.name: Dire Wail
entries: You let forth a wail filled with otherworldly power. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 4d10} thunder damage and be {@condition deafened} for the duration. At the end of each turn, targets can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on a success. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not deafened.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d10|3-9|1d10} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Elemental Bane (Alternate)
entries: Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder; and one creature within range. It must make Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with an elemental curse, and if it has Resistance to the damage type you chose, it loses it for the duration.
The first time each turn a cursed creature takes damage of the chosen type, it takes a bonus {@damage 1d6} damage, then it repeats the Constitution saving throw, ending the curse on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, you can either increase the bonus damage by {@scaledamage 1d6|3-9|1d6}, or target another creature within range, for each spell slot level above 4th. If you target more than one creature, you use the same damage type for all taragets of the spell.

spell.name: Flame Arrows (Alternate)
entries: You touch a quiver containing ranged weapon ammunition. The first twelve pieces of ammunition drawn from the quiver deal fire damage in place of their normal damage type, plus an additional {@damage 1d6} fire damage on hit. If fired into a flammable object, it bursts into flame on hit. The magic of this spell ends for each piece of ammunition when it hits or misses, and the spell ends after twelve pieces of ammunition are fired.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, you can draw two additional pieces of ammunition from the quiver for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Grasping Vine (Alternate)
entries: You cause a vine to sprout from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast this spell, the vine strikes at a target you can see within 30 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack against the target, and on hit, it takes {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, then it is pulled up to 30 feet toward the vine and {@condition Restrained} by it.
As an action, a Restrained creature can make a Strength or Dexterity check against your Spell save DC to escape.
As a bonus action on each subsequent turn, you can cause the vine to strike at another target. If the vine is Restraining a creature, it instead deals {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage to it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell with a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the vine deals an additional {@scaledamage 2d8|3-9|1d8} damage on hit for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Hunger of Hadar (Alternate)

components.m: pickled octopus tentacle

entries: You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region infested with unknown horrors. A 20-foot-radius sphere of blackness and bitter cold appears, centered on a point with range and lasting for the duration. This void is filled with a cacophony of soft whispers and slurping noises that can be heard up to 30 feet away. No light, magical or otherwise, can illuminate the area, and creatures in the area are {@condition blinded}.

The void creates a warp in the fabric of space, and the area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Any creature that starts its turn in the area takes {@damage 2d6} cold damage. Any creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 2d6} acid damage as milky, otherworldly tentacles rub against it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the radius of the spell increases by 5 feet and both the cold and acid damage each increase by {@scaledamage 2d6|3-9|1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Hypnotic Pattern (Alternate)

components.m: a glowing stick of incense

entries: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. This psychedelic pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes {@condition charmed} for the duration. While charmed by this spell, the creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0.

An affected creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The spell also ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake it out of its stupor.

spell.name: Irresistible Dance (Alternate)
entries: You force a creature that can hear you within range to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be {@condition charmed} are immune to this spell.

This creature must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls. While the target is affected by this spell, creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. As an action, a dancing creature makes a Wisdom saving throw to regain control of itself, ending the spell on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, you target one additional creature who can hear you within range for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Lightning Arrow (Alternate)
entries: As part of a ranged weapon attack, you can transmute a piece of ammunition, or the thrown weapon, into a bolt of lightning. On hit, the target takes the normal damage of the attack, plus a bonus {@damage 4d8} lighting damage. On a miss, the target takes half as much lightning damage, and none of the normal damage.

Regardless if this attack hits or misses, all creatures within 10 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, creatures take {@damage 2d8} lighting damage, and half as much lighting damage on a success. The piece of ammunition or thrown weapon then returns to its normal form.
Any creature that takes lighting damage from this spell cannot take reactions until the beginning of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the damage for both effects of the spell increases by {@scaledamage 4d8;2d8|3-9|1d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Sonic Wave
entries: You forcefully clasp your hands and a shockwave of booming force shoots forth from you and emits a boom audible out to 500 feet. All creatures in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 4d8} thunder damage, fall {@condition prone}, and be {@condition deafened} for 1 minute. On a success, creatures take half damage and are not knocked prone or deafened.
A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|3-9|1d8}, and the cone increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Speak with Dead (Alternate)

m.text: two gold coins, consumed by the spell

entries: You grant a semblance of life and intelligence to a Humanoid corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer your questions. It must still have a mouth and it cannot be Undead. If this corpse was the target of another speak with dead spell in the past 10 days, this casting of the spell fails.

While the spell lasts, the spellcaster can ask the corpse up to three questions. Any answers requested beyond a "yes" or "no" are brief and cryptic. The corpse is not compelled to give truthful answers, especially if the spellcaster was Hostile to it or it recognizes the spellcaster as an enemy.

This spell does not return the soul to the corpse's body, but draws out the imprint of its consciousness from the moments before its death. The corpse cannot learn new information, it cannot comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and it cannot speculate about the future.

spell.name: Spectral Passage

components.m: an object a spirit has passed through

entries: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, it becomes semi-incorporeal and can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. If the creature ends its movement inside another object or creature, it is immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space, taking {@damage 1d10} force damage for every 5 feet it was forced to travel.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Tiny Hut (Alternate)

components.m: a pearl cut perfectly in half

entries: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of arcane force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area.

Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome with you. The spell fails if its area includes any Large creatures or more than nine creatures. Creatures and objects within the dome when you cast this spell can move through it freely. All other creatures and objects cannot pass through it. Spells and other magical effects cannot extend through the dome or be cast through it. The atmosphere inside the dome is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside.
Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to be dimly lit or dark. The dome is opaque and dull in color as to blend in with surroundings. It is transparent from the inside.

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The dome has 100 hit points and Armor Class equal to your Spell save DC. It is immune to poison, psychic, and non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, it is vulnerable to force and all magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and it is resistant to all other damage types. A {@spell disintegrate} spell destroys it instantly.

spell.name: Accursed Touch

components.m: a basilisk scale

entries: You attempt to transmute a creature into stone. As an action, you touch a creature, forcing it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition Restrained} as its flesh begins to harden. On a successful save, it is not affected.

A creature Restrained by this spell must make another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it saves against this spell three times, the spell ends. Should it fail three saves, it is turned to stone and {@condition Petrified}. Successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the creature fails or passes three saves.
If the target is physically broken while Petrified, it suffers from similar deformities if it reverts to its original state.
If you maintain your concentration for the entire duration, the creature is turned to stone until the effect is removed.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the number of saves that the target must fail before it is turned to stone and Petrified is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1) for each level above 4th.

spell.name: Conjure Aberration

m.text: a prisim worth at least 50 gold, bathed in the aberrant energies of the Far Realm

entries: You grasp the material component of this spell, tearing a rift in reality, causing an Aberration to appear in range. For the duration, the Aberration uses the rules below:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: When you cast the spell, roll a {@dice d4} and consult the table below. The Aberration corresponding to your result appears, using its stat block. Alternately, you can choose any result lower than yours to appear in its place.

entries.name: Combat
entries: The Aberration shares your initiative and acts on your turn. You can give it verbal order (no action required). If the Aberration does not receive any orders, or its orders are completed, it moves and defends itself with prejudice.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

entries.name: Control
entries: If the spell ends because your concentration was broken, the Aberration remains, but is no longer under your control. For the duration of the spell, or until it is reduced to 0 hit points, the Aberration acts according to its alignment.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th-level or higher, you gain a +1 bonus to your roll to determing the Aberration conjured for each slot above 4th.

spell.name: Create Undead (Alternate)

m.text: the corpse of a creature slain within the last day, and blood from the spellcaster, both of which are consumed by the casting of this spell

entries: This spell can only be cast at night. You spill your blood onto the corpse as part of a sinister ritual, reducing your maximum hit points by 2 and creating a {@creature Skeleton} or {@creature Zombie} under your control. Undead created by this spell use the rules below:

entries.name: Control
entries: Undead follow your commands without quesion. If not given a command, an Undead won't move and will only act to defend itself. In combat, any Undead you created share your initiative and act during your turn.

As a bonus action, you can mentally command any number of Undead you created with within 120 feet. You can issue an individual command to each, determining exactly how it will act, or setting a general course of action ("defend this hall"). So long as they remain under your control, your Undead will follow commands until completed.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

entries.name: Undead Bond
entries: While an Undead is under your control, you cannot regain the maximum hit points you spent to create it. However, when you finish a long rest, you can release control over any Undead that you created to regain the maximum hit points you spent to create them. When freed, Undead become hostil to all living things, the spellcaster in particular.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: You can cast this spell with a spell slot of a higher level, and expend additional maximum hit points (Max. HP) to create more powerful Undead, as shown here:

spell.name: Death Ward (Alternate)
entries: You touch a creature and ward it against the touch of death. The first time the target starts its turn with 0 hit points, but is not dead, it can stand up with 1 hit point, and the spell ends.
If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target, and the spell ends.

spell.name: Dominate Creature
entries: You attempt to beguile a Beast that you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition Charmed} by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are Friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on its saving throw.

While Charmed, you share a telepathic link with the Beast so long as you are on the same plane. You can issue orders to the creature through this link, which it does its best to follow, so long as you are not {@condition Incapacitated}. You can give specific or general orders, such as "attack that creature" or "protect that door". When the creature does not have an order to follow, it will defend itself to the best of its abilities.

As an action, you can take complete control of the creature until the start of your next turn. When you do so, it takes only the actions you choose and nothing beyond it. You can cause it to use a reaction, but you must use your reaction as well.
Any time the creature takes damage, it repeats its Wisdom saving throw, ending this effect on a successful save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: As you cast this spell with a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the spell's effects increase, as shown here:

rows: The spell can target any creature

spell.name: Ego Scourge
entries: You strike at the mind of a creature you can see within range, attacking its sense of self. It must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and be unable to cast spells for the duration.
At the end of each of its turns the creature can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect of this spell on a success.

spell.name: Eldritch Tentacles

components.m: a piece of tentacle from a giant squid

entries: Alien tentacles fill a 20-foot square on the ground you can see within range. For the duration, this area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

When a creature enters this area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage and be {@condition restrained} by the tentacles until the spell ends. Any creature that begins its turn in the area and is restrained by the tentacles takes {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage at the start of its turn.
A creature restrained by the tentacles can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the tentacles.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, both instances of damage from this spell increase by {@scaledamage 3d6|4-9|1d6} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Pillars of Earth
entries: You cause up to two pillars of stone to burst forth from places on the ground that you can see within range. Both pillars are cylinders with a diameter of 5 feet and a height up to 30 feet.

The ground where a pillar appears must be wide enough for its diameter, and you can target ground under a creature if that creature is Medium or smaller. Each pillar has an Armor Class of 5 and 30 hit points. If reduced to 0 hit points, a pillar crumbles into rubble, creating an area of {@quickref difficult terrain||3} with a 10-foot radius. This rubble lasts until cleared.
If a pillar is created under a creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be lifted by the pillar. A creature can choose to fail the save.

If a pillar is prevented from reaching its full height because of a ceiling or other obstacle, any creature on the pillar takes {@damage 6d6} bludgeoning damage and is {@condition Restrained}, pinched between the pillar and the obstacle. A Restrained creature can use its action to make either a Strength or Dexterity check against your Spell save DC. On a success, it is no longer Restrained and must either move off the pillar or fall off it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell with a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you create two additional pillars for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Polymorph (Alternate)

components.m: a caterpillar cocoon

entries: You attempt to transform a creature you can see within range into a Beast using the rules below. An unwilling target makes a Charisma saving throw to resist this effect. Shapechangers automatically succeed on this saving throw.

entries.name: Form
entries: The new form can be any living Beast you have seen before. Creatures can only be transformed into a Beast with a CR equal to (or lower then) half its level or CR.

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The creature's game statistics are replaced by those of the Beast. However, while transformed, it retains its alignment, personality, its {@u Hit Points}, and Charisma score.

entries.name: Actions
entries: The creature can only take the actions that would be available to that Beast. It cannot speak, cast spells, or take any actions that require hands or speech.

entries.name: Equipment
entries: Its clothing, weapons, armor, and objects it is holding meld into the new form. However, it can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

entries.name: Reverting
entries: The creature instantly reverts to its true form if it is reduced to 0 hit points. It can also repeat this Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns, reverting to its true form on a successful save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a slot of 5th-level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th. You can choose the Beast that you transform each target into individually.

spell.name: Staggering Smite (Alternate)

m.text: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

entries: When you hit with a melee weapon attack you can cause the weapon to pierce both body and mind. This attack deals {@damage 4d6} additional psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or until the start of its next turn, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks and it cannot take reactions.
If your target is an aberration or it can speak telepathically this bonus psychic damage increases by {@damage 1d6}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th-level or higher, the psychic damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6;5d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Wall of Ice (Alternate)

components.m: a small piece of quartz

entries: You create a 1-foot thick wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You create it as a hemispherical dome or a sphere with radius of up to 10 feet, or you shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels. All panels must be contiguous with another panel. The ice wall lasts for the duration.

When the wall appears, creatures in its space must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, you decide which side of the wall they are pushed to, then they take {@damage 6d6} cold damage. On a success, they decide which side they are pushed to, and they take half as much cold damage.

The wall has an AC of 12, 30 hit points per 10-foot section, and it is Vulnerable to fire damage. When a 10-foot section is destroyed, a sheet of frigid air remains in that space. When a creature passes through a sheet of this frigid air it must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes {@damage 2d6} cold damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. A creature can only be forced to make this saving throw once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th-level or higher, the damage the wall deals when it appears increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|4-9|2d6}, and damage from passing through a sheet of frigid air increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|4-9|1d6}, for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Wall of Thorns (Alternate)

components.m: a handful of thorns

entries: You conjure a wall of thick plant growth bristling with thorns hard as iron. It appears in range on a solid surface. The wall can be up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick. Or, it forms a 20-foot diameter circle, 20 feet high and 5 feet thick.

When it appears, creatures within it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take {@damage 5d8} piercing damage and remain within the wall. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and move to an adjacent space of its choice not within the area of the wall.

entries.name: Moving Through
entries: Any creature can painfully move through the wall, but it must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves within it. The first time a creature enters the wall or begins its turn in it, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes {@damage 5d8} piercing damage on a failure, half on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a slot of 5th level or higher, both instances of damage increase by {@scaledamage 5d8|4-9|1d8} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Banishing Smite (Alternate)

m.text: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

entries: When you hit with a melee weapon attack you can cause the weapon to crackle with pure arcane force. This attack deals {@damage 5d10} bonus force damage, and if it reduces the target to 50 hit points or fewer, it is banished from the current plane.

If the target is native to a different plant of existence than the one you are currently on, it disappears, returning to its home plane. If the target is native to your current plane, it is banished to a harmless demiplane where it is {@condition incapacitated}. When the spell ends, the target returns to the space it was banished from, or the nearest unoccupied space.
If the target is not native to your current plane of existence this bonus force damage increases by {@damage 1d10}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th-level or higher, the bonus force damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d10;6d10|5-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Conjure Celestial (Alternate)

components.m: a Celestial's true name

entries: Speaking its true name, you conjure a {@filter Celestial of CR 5 or lower|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&5]|type=celestial} to aid you. This Celestial is Friendly to you and your allies, obeys your commands, and uses the rules below:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The Celestial appears in an unoccupied space of your choice you can see in range. When it appears, you can cause it to take on the appearance and statistics of a different Celestial of your choice equal to its CR, or lower.

entries.name: Combat
entries: This Celestial shares your initiative and it acts during your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Celestial does not receive a command, or its commands are completed, it will move and defend itself.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the CR of the Celestials that you can conjure increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Conjure Dragon

m.text: the scale of an Ancient Dragon, inlaid with gems worth at last 500 gold, willingly gifted to you

entries: Grasping the material component of this spell, you conjure a portion of that Ancient Dragon's essence to your aid. While your concentration lasts, it is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. For the duration, this draconic essence uses the rules below:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The draconic essence manifests in the form of a {@filter Dragon of your choice of CR 5 or lower|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&5]|type=dragon}, however, the color of its scales, its damage resistance, and the damage dealt by its breath weapon change to match that of the dragon which provided the material component of this spell. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range.

entries.name: Combat
entries: In combat, this Dragon shares your initiative and acts on your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Dragon does not receive any commands, or if its commands are completed, it defend itself with prejudice.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

entries.name: Control
entries: If your concentration ends, the Dragon instantly disappears, the essence returning to the Ancient Dragon.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the CR of Dragon this essence can manifest increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Conjure Giant

m.text: a gemstone worth at least 500 gold, personally inscribed with the Rune of a Storm Giant

entries: Grasping the material component of this spell, you conjure a portion of that Storm Giants's essence to your aid. While your concentration lasts, it is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. For the duration, this titanic essence uses the rules below:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The titanic essence manifests in the form of a {@creature Hill Giant}, and uses the corresponding stat block. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range.

entries.name: Combat
entries: In combat, this Giant shares your initiative and acts on your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Giant does not receive any commands, or if its commands are completed, it defend itself with prejudice.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

entries.name: Control
entries: If your concentration ends, the Giant instantly disappears, the essence returning to the Storm Giant.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: You can cast this spell with higher level spell slots to cause this titanic essence to take on the form of more powerful Giants, as shown in the table below:

spell.name: Create Construct

m.text: high quality materials worth at least 200 gold per level of the spell, all of which are consumed

entries: Using a set of {@item artisan's tools|PHB} with which you are proficient, you set to work creating a creation of arcane power. Once the spell is complete, the material components are transformed into a Golem Servant, which uses the rules below:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The {@creature Golem Servant|llspell} uses the stat block below. It uses your Spellcasting Ability, the Spell Slot spent to cast this spell, your Spell Attack Modifier, and Proficiency Bonus (PB) in several places throughout the stat block. You choose if your Golem is Medium or Large sized, and its appearance reflects the materials you used in its creation.

entries.name: Control
entries: Your Golem has no mind of its own and obeys you absolutely. In combat, it shares your initiative and acts during your turn. However, unless you give it a command, the Golem Servant remains in its space and will only act in self defense. If you are within 500 feet of your Golem, you can use a bonus action to Telepathically issue it a command, determining how it will act on its turn or to set a general course of action for it (ie: "defend this creature") until you give it another command.

entries.name: Magical Nature
entries: The Golem cannot benefit from healing spells, nor short or long rests. The only way for it to regain hit points is for a creature to touch it and spend one spell slot. It then regains hit points equal to 10 times the slot's level.

entries.name: Creator's Bond
entries: While the Golem lives, you cannot regain the spell slot you expended to create it, and casting this spell again instantly destroys any previous Golem Servants.

spell.name: Psychic Crush
entries: You exert the full force of your will upon a creature you can see within range. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} force damage on a failure and half as much force damage on a success. It must repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking {@damage 2d8} force damage on a failure, and ending the effects of this spell on a success.
If this spell reduces a creature to 0 hit points it is crushed into a flesh-colored ball, roughly the size of your fist.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th-level or higher, each instance of force damage it deals increases by {@scaledamage 5d8;2d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Spiritual Sundering
entries: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range have their soul rent, and must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they take {@damage 8d6} necrotic damage, and for the next minute, they have a muddied sense of self and subtract {@dice 1d6} from any Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw they make. On a success, they take half damage and suffer no saving throw penalty.
Targets can make a Charisma saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a successful save.

activation.condition: When an affected creature makes an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw

spell.name: Steel Wind Strike (Alternate)

m.text: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

entries: You flourish the weapon used in the casting and then vanish to strike like the wind. Choose up to five targets you can see within range. Make one melee weapon attack against each target using the weapon used in the casting. On a hit, targets take the normal damage of an attack with that weapon plus an additional {@damage 5d10} force damage.
You can then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of one of the targets you hit or missed.

spell.name: Swift Quiver (Alternate)

components.m: a quiver with a piece of ammunition

entries: You transmute your quiver so it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition, which seems to leap into your hand when you reach for it.

On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action (including the bonus action used to cast this spell) to make two attacks with a ranged weapon that uses ammunition from this quiver. When you make such a ranged attack, your quiver magically replaces the ammunition you used with a nonmagical copy of that ammunition. Pieces of ammunition created by this spell disintegrate when the spell ends. If the quiver leaves your possession, the spell ends.

spell.name: Vorpal Blade

components.m: the finger bone of a necromancer

entries: You conjure a blade of pure negative energy in your empty hand and make one melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach, attempting to behead it. On hit, it takes force damage equal to {@damage 6d8} + your spellcasting modifier.
If this damage reduces the creature to 50 hit points or fewer, you instantly cut off one of its heads of your choice
The creature instantly dies if it cannot survive without the lost head. The creature's head is not removed if it is immune to slashing damage, or if it doesn't have or need a head.

spell.name: Wall of Force (Alternate)

components.m: powder from crushed clear gemstone

entries: A shimmering wall of magical force springs into existence at a point you choose within range and lasts for the duration.

entries.name: Orientation & Shape
entries: The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or an angle. It can be free floating or rest on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome, a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick. Nothing can pass through the wall physically, and anything viewed through it is lightly obscured. The wall extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through the wall. If it cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it chooses which side of the wall it moves to. On a failure, you choose the side it moves to.

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The wall has 150 hit points and its Armor Class equals your Spell save DC. It is immune to poison, psychic, and non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, vulnerable to force and magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and resistant to all other damage types. It cannot be dispelled by a {@spell dispel magic} spell, but a {@spell disintegrate} spell destroys the wall it instantly.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th-level or higher, the hit points of the wall created by this spell increase by 25 for each spell slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Astral Blade
entries: You conjure a 3-foot blade of pure astral energy. It appears in a space you can see within range, and you instantly make two melee spell attacks with it against targets within 5 feet. Astral Blade attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20. On hit, they deal {@damage 4d6} force damage. On a critical hit, its target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished to a harmless Demiplane until the start of your next turn.
On subsequent turns, you can use a bonus action to move your Astral Blade up to 60 feet and make two attacks with it.
Your Astral Blade can harmlessly pass through any barrier created with magic, like those of a {@spell wall of force (alternate)|llspell|wall of force} spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th-level or higher, the force damage dealt by the Astral Blade increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|6-9|2d6} for each spell slot level above 6th.

spell.name: Create Monstrosity

m.text: the corpses of the appropriate Beasts and blood of the spellcaster, both of which are consumed

entries: You spill your blood onto the corpses binding them together into a new form, reducing your maximum hit points by 5 and creating a {@creature Hippogriff}, {@creature Griffon}, or {@creature Peryton} under your control. Monstrosities created by this spell use the rules below:

entries.name: Control
entries: As a bonus action, you can mentally command any Monstrosities created by this spell, so long as they are within 60 feet. You determine how they act or set a general course of action for them ("defend this dungeon"). Monstrosities follow commands until they are complete. If your Monstrosity is not given a command, it defends itself with extreme prejudice.

entries.name: Creator's Bond
entries: While a Monstrosity is under your control you can't regain the maximum hit points spent in its creation. However, when you finish a long rest, you can release control over a Monstrosity to regain the maximum hit points spent to create it. When released, Monstrosities becomes hostile to all living things, the spellcaster that created it in particular.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: You can cast this spell with a spell slot of a higher level, and expend maximum hit points (Max. HP) to create more powerful Monstrosities, as shown here:

spell.name: Astral Projection (Alternate)

m.text: a 10-foot long cord of mithril worth 1,000 gold for each target, which the spell consumes

entries: You separate your soul from your body, projecting it into the Astral Plane (The spell fails if you cast it on the Astral Plane). Your physical body is left behind, {@condition Unconscious} and in a state of suspended animation; it does not need air, food, nor water, and it does not age. Your soul uses the following rules:

entries.name: Astral Body
entries: Your soul forms an Astral Body around itself. It is an exact replica of your physical body with your statistics and posessions, though a silver cord extends from the center of its back, turning invisibile after 1 foot. Any damage or other effects that apply to it don't affect your physical body or carry over to it when you return to your body.

entries.name: Silver Cord
entries: This cord tethers your soul to your physical body, and as long as it is intact, you can find your way to your physical body. If the cord is severed (which only happens if an effect specifically states that it does), your soul and body are permanently separated, killing you instantly.

entries.name: Ending the Spell
entries: If you leave the Astral Plane through a portal to another plane or return to the plane where the spell was cast, your physical body and its possessions travel along your silver cord, and you re-enter your physical body there.

The spell ends if you use your action to end it, if a spell like {@spell dispel magic} is cast on your Astral Body or physical body, or if either body is reduced to 0 hit points. When the spell ends in this way, your soul instantly travels along your silver cord and returns to your physical body, where you awaken.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell with a spell slot of 7th-level or higher, you can target three additional creatures for each spell slot level above 6th.
Any additional creatures must remain within 10 feet of you while you cast the spell.

spell.name: Create Homunculus (Alternate)

m.text: clay, a sapphire worth 500 gold, and blood from the spellcaster, all of which are consumed

entries: While muttering incantations, you spill your blood onto the sapphire and place it at the heart of the clay, which you shape into your Homunculus. Your maximum hit points are reduced by {@dice 2d4} (this can't be lessened in any way), and a Homunculus comes to life under your control using the rules below:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The {@creature Homunculus (Alternate)|llspell|Homunculus} uses the stat block below. It uses your Spellcasting Ability, the Spell Slot spent to cast this spell, your Spell Attack Modifier, and Proficiency Bonus (PB) in several places throughout the stat block.

entries.name: Control
entries: Your Homunculus is absolutely loyal to you as its creator. It acts independently of you, but you can choose how it acts. In combat, it shares your initiative and your turn.

entries.name: Lifeblood Bond
entries: While your Homunculus lives, you cannot regain the maximum hit points spent in its creation. Casting this spell again instantly destroys any previous Homunculus.

The Homunculus cannot benefit from healing spells, short, or long rests. However, whenever you regain hit points (from a spell or rest), you can forgo regaining any number of those hit points and cause the Homunculus to regain them in your stead, so long as you are on the same plane of existence.
Finally, if you should die, the Homunculus dies instantly.

spell.name: Elemental Avatar
entries: You draw upon the chaotic energies of the elemental planes, infusing yourself with pure elemental Air, Earth, Fire, or Ice. For the duration, you gain the benefits of that element:

entries.name: Air
entries: A vortex of wind swirls about you, causing all ranged weapon attacks targeting you to be made with disadvantage, and granting you a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

As an action, you can unleash a tempestuous burst, forcing creatures within 15 feet to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@damage 4d8} thunder damage and are pushed away from you 15 feet in a straight line. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and are not moved.

entries.name: Earth
entries: Your body is covered in a shifting layer of raw earth and stone, granting you Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. You can also ignore any difficult terrain imposed by earth, stone, sand, or similar materials.

As an action, you rend the earth at your feet out to a 15-foot radius turning it into difficult terrain and forcing all creatures in that area to make a Dexterity saving throw. They take {@damage 4d8} bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition Prone} on a failed save, and half as much damage and do not fall Prone on a success.

entries.name: Fire
entries: Flames envelop your body, harmless to you. You gain Immunity to fire damage, Resistance to radiant damage, and you shed bright light out to a 30-foot radius.

As an action, you unleash a burst of searing fire, forcing all creatures within 15 feet to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take {@damage 4d8} fire damage and are {@condition Blinded} until the start of your next turn. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not Blinded.

entries.name: Ice
entries: A thin sheen of glacial frost covers your body. You gain Immunity to cold damage, and the area within 15 feet of you becomes difficult terrain for creatures other than you due to the frigid temperature emitting from your body.

As an action, you can flash freeze the area within 15 feet, forcing creatures to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take {@damage 4d8} cold damage and their speed is halved until the start of your next turn. On a success, they take half as much damage and their speed is not affected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th-level or higher, you gain the benefits of another element of your choice (you can only choose each element once), and the damage of the special actions granted by this spell increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Psionic Oppression
entries: You psionically overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range. It must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or it takes {@damage 12d6} psychic damage and is {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target takes half as much psychic damage and is not stunned.
The stunned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

spell.name: Create Simulacrum

m.text: snow, the severed finger of the target, and two rubies worth 500 gold, all of which is consumed

entries: While maintaining unwavering focus, you sculpt snow into a duplicate of a Humanoid within range for the entire casting. Placing its severed finger in its place and using the rubies as eyes, the Simulacrum comes to life, using these rules:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The Simulacrum uses the same statistics as the target Humanoid, but its creature type is Construct, it cannot regain hit points or benefit from short or long rests, and it is vulnerable to fire damage (due to being made of snow).

entries.name: Control
entries: The Simulacrum is absolutely loyal to you and it obeys any orders you give it without hesitation. In combat, the Simulacrum shares your initiative and acts during your turn.

entries.name: Illusory Being
entries: The Simulacrum cannot gain experience or levels, and it can't learn new abilities or spells of any kind.
The only way for the Simulacrum to regain hit points is for a creature to touch it and spend a spell slot. The Simulacrum then regains hit points equal to 10 times that slot's level.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If the target creature can cast spells, you can command the Simulacrum to cast them, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast spells without expending spell slots.

entries.name: Paradoxical Prevention
entries: Casting this spell again instantly destroys any other Simulacrums you have created. Moreover, each individual creature can only have one Simulacrum of it created at a time. Should another spellcaster uses this spell to craft a Simulacrum of a creature for which a Simulacrum already exists, the spell instantly fails and the slot is wasted.

spell.name: Forcecage (Alternate)

m.text: an ornate jade box worth 1,500 gp

entries: A shimmering, immobile, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area of your choice within range. You choose whether this magic prison is shaped like a cage with bars or a solid box.

entries.name: Shape
entries: If you choose cage, it can be up to 20 feet on a side and made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart. If you choose box, it can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out of the area. The cage extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel.

entries.name: Creatures Inside
entries: When you cast the spell, any creatures that are completely inside the area of the cage are trapped. Any creatures partially within the area, or too large to fit are pushed away until they are completely outside of the cage.

A creature inside the cage cannot leave it by non-magical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave the cage, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. The spell or effect is wasted on a failed save, but on a success the creature uses the spell or effect to escape.

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The cage's Armor Class equals your Spell save DC and it has 200 hit points. It is immune to poison, psychic, and non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, vulnerable to force and magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and resistant to all other damage types. It cannot be dispelled by a {@spell dispel magic} spell, but a {@spell disintegrate} spell destroys the cage it instantly.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th-level or higher, the hit points of the cage created by this spell increase by 25 for each spell slot level above 7th.

spell.name: Time Stop (Alternate)
entries: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take two turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.

This spell instantly ends if you move more than 1,000 feet from the location you cast it in, or if an action you use during the spell affects a creature other than you or an object that is being worn or carried by another creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th-level or higher, the number of turns you take while time is stopped increases by 1 for each spell slot level above 7th.

spell.name: Whirlwind (Alternate)

components.m: a single leaf or piece of straw

entries: You magically transmute the winds in the area to conjure a powerful tornado under your control. This whirlwind appears as a 10-foot radius, 50-foot high cylinder centered on a point you can see in range. With subsequent actions, you can move the whirlwind up to 30 feet in any direction along the ground.
The whirlwind sucks up any Medium or smaller objects that aren't being worn or carried or otherwise secured when they enter its space for the first time.

Any creature that enters the whirlwind's space must make a Strength saving throw. They take {@damage 10d6} thunder damage on a failure, and half as much on a successful save. Any Large or smaller creature that fails its saving throw is also sucked into the Whirlwind and {@condition Restrained} in it. Each creature can only be forced to make this saving throw once per turn.

Restrained creatures move with the Whirlwind, and at the start of each of its turns it is Restrained within it, it takes {@damage 2d6} thunder damage and moves 10 feet up within the whirlwind. When a creature moves beyond the top of the whirlwind, it is thrown 60 feet in a random direction and lands {@condition Prone}.
As an action, any Restrained creature can make a Strength check against your Spell save DC. On a successful check, it is thrown from whirlwind 60 feet in a direction of its choice.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th-level or higher, the whirlwind is 10 feet taller and it deals an additional {@scaledamage 10d6;2d6|7-9|2d6} thunder damage every time it deals damage for each slot level above 7th.

spell.name: Animal Shapes (Alternate)
entries: You use elder magicks to transmute yourself and others into animal forms. Choose any number of willing creatures within range to transform into Beasts, using the following rules:

entries.name: Form
entries: Each creature is transformed into a {@filter Beast of CR 4 or lower|bestiary|type=Beast|challenge rating=[&0;&4]} that you have seen before. You can choose different form for each target. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform one target of this spell within 30 feet into another Beast, using the same restrictions.

entries.name: Statistics
entries: The creature's game statistics are replaced by those of the Beast. However, while transformed, it retains its alignment, personality, its {@u Hit Points}, and Charisma score.

entries.name: Actions
entries: The creature can only take the actions that would be available to that Beast. It cannot speak, cast spells, or take any actions that require hands or speech.

entries.name: Equipment
entries: Its clothing, weapons, armor, and objects it is holding meld into the new form. However, it can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

entries.name: Reverting
entries: A creature instantly reverts to its true form if it is reduced to 0 hit points. It can also revert to its normal form early as an action. However, once it returns to its normal form the effects of this spell end for it.

spell.name: Antipathy (Alternate)

components.m: a spoonfull of vinegar for antipathy, or a drop of honey for sympathy

entries: You infuse a Huge or smaller object with powerful repulsive magic, choosing a type of intelligent creature such as bronze dragons, trolls, or hags. For the duration, this object emits a 60-foot aura of magic which repels that type of creature.

entries.name: Effects
entries: If the chosen creature can see the object or enters its magic aura, it feels an intense urge to flee, and must make a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition Frightened} of the object.

It is Frightened so long as it can see the object, or while it remains in its magical aura. While Frightened, it must use its movement to flee from the object to the nearest safe location outside of its magic aura where it cannot see the object. Once a creature does so, it is no longer Frightened of the object.
The creature becomes Frightened of this object again if it can see it or if it reenters the object's magical aura.

entries.name: Ending this Effect
entries: If an effected creature can no longer see the object and is outside of its magic aura, it can use its action to repeat the Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature knows the effect is magical in nature, and it gains immunity to the effect for 1 minute.

entries.name: Inverse Casting
entries: You can use this spell to infuse {@i sympathy} into an object instead. If a chosen creature can see the object or moves within its magic aura, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or use all its movement on each turn to move as close to the object as it can. Once it does so, it can't willingly move away from the object. If the target takes damage while under this effect, it can end the effect as described above.

spell.name: Shapechange (Alternate)

m.text: three interwoven circlets of gold, platinum, and lead, worth at least 1,500 gold

entries: You place the material component of this spell on your head and transform into a {@filter creature|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&10]|type=!construct;!undead|miscellaneous=!spellcaster} of CR equal to half your level, or lower. It cannot be a Construct or Undead, and you must have seen a living specimen of that creature before. It is an average specimen of that creature, and it cannot have class levels or the Spellcasting feature.

entries.name: Statistics
entries: Your game statistics are replaced by the chosen creature's, though, you retain your alignment, personality, {@u hit points}, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You retain your proficiencies and gain those of the creature. If you both share a proficiency, you can use the higher bonus.
You cannot use Legendary Resistances, Legendary Actions, or Lair Actions even if the chosen creature has them.

entries.name: Features
entries: You retain your features and can use them so long as the chosen creature is capable of doing so. You don't retain special senses, but use the senses of the creature.

entries.name: Equipment
entries: You choose whether your equipment falls to the ground, merges with your new form, or is worn by it. Your equipment does not change size to fit your new form, and you only retain its benefits if the creature you transform into can wear and use the object.

entries.name: Shifting
entries: While the spell lasts, you can use your action to transform again, taking the shape of another creature of your choice, following the same rules and restrictions above.

spell.name: Storm of Vengeance (Alternate)
entries: You conjure a terrifying mass of storm clouds centered on a point you can see, spreading outward to a radius of 360 feet. You are completely immune to the effects of this dark storm. Violent winds, thunder, and lighting fill the storm, forcing all creatures within and below the storm to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@damage 2d6} thunder damage and are {@condition Deafened} while they remain in the area.

Each subsequent round the storm lasts, you can use your action to add (or end) one of the weather effects below, which lasts for the duration. They affect all creatures and objects in and below the storm, and each can only be added once:

entries.name: Acid Rain
entries: Acidic rain falls from the clouds, dealing {@damage 1d6} acid damage to all creatures at the end of each of your turns.

entries.name: Freezing Rain
entries: Frigid rain falls from the clouds. The area becomes {@quickref difficult terrain||3} and heavily obscured. Targets in the area take {@damage 1d6} cold damage at the end of each of your turns.

entries.name: Hail Stones
entries: You infuse the storm with bitter cold. At the end of each of your turns, creatures and objects in the area take {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage and crops are destroyed.

entries.name: High Winds
entries: Strong winds up to 50 miles per hour rage, instantly dispersing all fog, mist, or similar effects, mundane or magical. Ranged attacks in the area become impossible.

entries.name: Lightning Strikes
entries: You charge the storm with lightning. As a bonus action on each turn, you can call six bolts of lighting from the cloud, each striking targets of your choice within the area. They must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d6} lighting damage on a failure, and half on a success.

spell.name: True Polymorph (Alternate)

components.m: a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke

entries: You point your finger at one creature or non-magical object you can see in range, transforming it in one of the ways listed below. An unwilling target makes a Charisma saving throw to resist this effect, and Shapechangers automatically succeed on this saving throw. This spell cannot affect a target with 0 hit points, or an object that is being worn or carried.
If you concentrate on the effect for the full duration of this spell, the transformation becomes permanent for your target.

entries.name: Creature to Creature
entries: The creature is transformed into another creature of a CR equal to (or lower then) half its CR or level. You must have seen a living specimen of the creature before in order to transform the target into that creature. The targets's game statistics are replaced by those of the creature, only retaining its alignment, personality, and {@u Hit Points}. All of its gear merges with its new form, and it cannot activate, use, or benefit from it while transformed. It can only take actions available to its new form, including speech, spellcasting, and things that require specific anatomy, such as hands.

entries.name: Creature to Object
entries: The creature is transformed into a non-magical object equal to its size or smaller. Everything it is wearing or carrying is transformed with it. You must have seen this object before to transform the creature into it. The target's statistics are replaced with those of the object. If the transformation ends, the target has no memory of the time it spent as the object.

entries.name: Object to Creature
entries: The non-magical object transforms into a creature equal to the objects size (or smaller) of CR 9 or lower. You must have seen a live specimen of the creature before in order to transform the object into that creature. Its statistics are replaced by those of the creature, it is Friendly to you and your allies, it rolls its own initative in combat, and you decide how it acts. Should the spell becomes permanent the new creature becomes independent, and it decides how to relate to you based how it was treated under your control.

entries.name: Object ot Object
entries: The non-magical object is transformed into another non-magical object you have seen before, of its size or smaller. It statistics are replaced by the new object.

spell.name: Weird (Alternate)
entries: Drawing on the deepest fears, regrets, and primal instincts of a creature, you create the illusion of the most horrifying thing imaginable to them, which is visible only to that creature.

Choose a point within range, and creatures of your choice within a 30-foot radius of the point become {@condition Frightened} for the duration. If a target is immune to the Frightened condition, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened anyway.
At the end of each of a Frightened creature's turns, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or it takes {@damage 4d10} psychic damage. On a success, the spell ends for that target.
